summary: Eastern US Lookouts lists an Astor forest lookout in Lake County under the Ocala National Forest; no other source found describes the tower or its site.

evidence.supports: Managing agency is the Ocala National Forest
Astor is a community in Lake County, Florida
Astor is an unincorporated community (census-designated place)
evidence.quote: Astor is an unincorporated community and census-designated place (CDP)

notes_for_editor: The only tower-specific source is a stub listing that gives name, county and agency. Two web searches and several page reads found no build date, design, staffing, fire or fate record for Astor. The 2010 Firehouse/WFTV item (https://www.firehouse.com/community-risk/news/10465752/fla-fire-towers-being-sold-off) says Lake County had four towers with two left and that a Leesburg tower was auctioned, but it does not name Astor, so it is left out of the story. The agency comes from the listing only and is not confirmed with the Forest Service. The story is about 40 words, well under the 120-word target; hold it or accept it as a stub.
